card.name: Word starts with a c sound
card.fires_on: A short piece beginning with c (c, yc, roc, circ, monoc) that sits partway through a longer medical word, right before the rest of the word is completed.

modes.label: Split medical terms
modes.description: A c-starting piece inside a long clinical word such as tachycardia, monoclonal or circulatory.

modes.label: Other c pieces
modes.description: A lone c or C starting a split word or acronym, after a hyphen, slash or space.

card.writes: It seems to push toward continuing the word with a short ending like 'ess' or 'ulation', though the effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires when a long medical word is broken up and the next piece starts with the letter c.
